Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_PRO_ST
Description: Arm posture twist from the equipped chest armour. Row ID = posture type × 100 + the armour's Posture Control ID; for the arm values the larger of this and the weapon's value is used.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Arm sideways (inside/outside) twist. This param is its only source, and it applies in every stance (one-handed and two-handed). Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Right arm forward/back twist. Combined with the weapon's value (PostureControlParam_WepRight): the one with the larger magnitude is used. When one-handing, using paired weapons or riding it moves the right arm forward/back; when two-handing it raises/lowers both arms. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Left arm_inside and outside

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Arm - Front/Back
Fields.Description: Left arm forward/back twist. Combined with the weapon values (PostureControlParam_WepRight while two-handing, PostureControlParam_WepLeft otherwise): the one with the larger magnitude is used. Applied only when one-handing, using paired weapons or riding. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. 0 is no twist.
